id: F-010
category: bad-gate
expect: flagged
area: build
phase: 01

# a structural check firing on a legitimate field

    if (key in current.fields) errors.push({ msg: "repeats key" })

`{}` carries Object.prototype's names, so a legitimate `constructor:` field was reported as a
repeated key. A BLOCK firing on a clean artifact -- the false-positive direction, which is
rarer and more corrosive than a miss, because it teaches people to ignore the gate.
